Streams the template spec, resources and /workspace. Secrets, network identity, approvals, checkpoints and Docker state are not included. A running sandbox is exported while it runs, so files written meanwhile may be inconsistent. A stopped one is started without services and stopped again.

post.description: Copies /workspace into a new VM built from the template, with the template's resources. Docker images, containers and volumes are lost. Tmux sessions end. A running sandbox is stopped for the copy and started again; a stopped one stays stopped. If the rebase fails, the sandbox stays on its old template in the state it was in.
